title: Body of a claims-stream event
description: kind is one of ASSERT, PROPOSE, CONFIRM, REJECT, CORRECT, SUPERSEDE, DISAVOW, DELETE. ASSERT/PROPOSE create a claim; others are transitions on claim_id. DELETE may carry derived_listed / destroy_derived / derived_kept_unusable (user's per-deletion choice, F-06) or cascade_of (deleted because the user chose to destroy it with its source).

content_ref.description: salted commitment 'c-'+sha256(salt+canonical(content)); content in content/claim_content.json unless destroyed by DELETE

medb_mediated.description: Principle 12: true = arose after known exposure to MedB output (exposure_refs, or confirmation of a proposal); 'possibly' = user ASSERT made after MedB had produced any output (F-19, D-47); false = before any MedB output

mediation_basis.description: ASSERT only: 'exposure_refs', or the first prior MedB output {stream, seq, kind}, or null
